title: Levels member stories
description: A cool-grey section with a centred eyebrow, title and lead over four white story cards with 32px corners and a soft long shadow: a 4:5 video still on top with a small white 'watch' pill, then a quote, a tracked capital name and a grey role. Four in a row on desktop, two on tablets, stacked on phones. On hover a card lifts 8px and its still zooms in a little.
notes: each still fills a 4:5 frame like object-fit: cover; empty, a grey placeholder stands in
